noris network.summary_note: noris network represents the highest level of jurisdictional sovereignty among German cloud providers surveyed. It is a founder-owned, privately held German AG with no non-EU ownership, no US subsidiary, and no CLOUD Act exposure — a complete contrast to providers like IONOS or T-Systems. Its sovereign cloud product (Wavestack, operated by subsidiary Wavecon GmbH) is built on the Sovereign Cloud Stack (SCS) open-source reference implementation, ensuring full software auditability and workload portability between SCS-certified providers. Its certification portfolio is exceptional: BSI C5:2020 Type II (2025), ISO 27001/IT-Grundschutz, ISAE 3402 Type II, PCI DSS 4.0, EN 50600 (Tier IV equivalent), and TÜViT Level 4 — among the highest standard combinations of any provider in this survey. The structural weaknesses are at the supply-chain layer: all hardware (Intel, AMD, NVIDIA, Lenovo) is non-EU in origin, firmware is US-controlled, and the company lacks the scale of larger EU providers for resilience across multiple EU regions. The €165M annual revenue and 10 data-centre footprint make it mid-tier in size. noris network is the reference choice for German KRITIS operators, financial institutions subject to ZAIT/BAIT, and public sector clients requiring maximum legal independence.
